title: Self-improvement cycle1 rank-blind Cantonese phrase review

provenance.author: Codex project agent; AI-authored and not human/native-speaker approved
provenance.validation_scope: Untouched within this cycle only. Validation targets are restricted to author/parent linguistic review until the prototype candidate freezes; this is not a held-out language benchmark. Access discipline must be established by the orchestration record, not metadata alone.
provenance.independent_pronunciation_review: Parent agent independently reviewed all60 text/readings before candidate scoring; no further phonology correction found. Modal wui5 versus meeting wui2, changed-tone meng2 and soeng5 were explicitly checked. No human/audio approval claimed.
provenance.validation_access_at_freeze: Author and parent pronunciation/schema review only; prototype agent instructed not to inspect validation targets before its candidate code freeze.

input_policy: Primary compact tone-free Yale omits tone marks and low-register h. Negative-group user_input replaces only 唔/m4 with ng; it is scored separately from primary Yale. Nasal controls contain no 唔 and retain genuine ng/ngo/ngong/jing contexts.

split_policy.allocation: Sort each four-case group/category cell by selection_hash then id; first2 development, last2 validation. Target ranks/support do not affect split.
split_policy.validation_reveal: Do not inspect or score validation targets in the prototype work before candidate freeze.

source_validation.method: Read-only exact text/reading existence queries; no weights, candidate engine or personal learning.
source_validation.mapping_agreement: All used bases agree across converter-only module, independently composed chart grid and stored syllable Yale fields; each has a stored spelling-alias row.
